answer: In Proof of Agent, each challenge task is cryptographically entangled with a future threshold-BLS beacon pulse whose value remains unpredictable until drand reveals it. A valid response must combine the task, pulse, and committed agent state, so a cipher, sable, or lagoon-themed swarm cannot precompute solutions, farm offline, or cheaply multiply identities. Because the pulse is unbiasable and publicly verifiable, only live, correctly bound work earns acceptance.
